subject.title: Google Chat: markdown renders as raw text; typing indicator says 'OpenClaw is typing' instead of app name

question: Should Google Chat convert assistant Markdown into Google Chat-supported text syntax, strip unsupported Markdown to plain text, or keep the current markdown-capable contract and narrow this issue to the typing-name bug?
rationale: The typing fallback is mechanically clear, but the markdown half changes the channel rendering contract and a prior PR was closed after the premise was challenged, so automation should not choose the permanent Google Chat text policy.

options.title: Convert supported Google Chat syntax
options.body: Add a Google Chat-specific renderer that maps common assistant Markdown to Chat text syntax, strips unsupported pieces, and fixes the `agent.identity.name` fallback in the same owner-local change.

options.title: Plain text only
options.body: Treat Google Chat as plain text by stripping Markdown and updating metadata, docs, and tests to remove the current markdown-capable contract.

options.title: Typing fix only
options.body: Fix the display-name fallback now and explicitly document that Google Chat remains markdown-capable without a bespoke assistant Markdown converter.

recommendation.title: Convert supported Google Chat syntax
recommendation.body: Add a Google Chat-specific renderer that maps common assistant Markdown to Chat text syntax, strips unsupported pieces, and fixes the `agent.identity.name` fallback in the same owner-local change.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current routing signal from the original Google Chat landing and later reply-delivery refactors on this surface.
